:::{#def-strict-local-minimizer}
#### Strict local minimizer

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$.
A point $\vx^*$ is a **strict local minimizer** of $f$
if there is a number $\tolin > 0$ such that $f(\vx^*) < f(\vx)$
for every $\vx \ne \vx^*$
in the [open ball](vector-calculus-hessian.qmd#def-ball) $\ball{\vx^*}{\tolin}$
of radius $\tolin$ around $\vx^*$.

:::
